definitions.explanation: A person who takes photographs professionally.

examples.japanese: {写真家|しゃしんか}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to become a photographer.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{写真家|しゃしんか}の{写真|しゃしん}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw photographs by a famous photographer.

examples.japanese: {風景|ふうけい}{写真家|しゃしんか}として{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: Working actively as a landscape photographer.

examples.japanese: その{写真家|しゃしんか}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}を{旅|たび}して{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}っている。
examples.english: That photographer travels the world taking photographs.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{写真家|しゃしんか}の{展覧会|てんらんかい}に{行|い}ったら、とても{美|うつく}しい{作品|さくひん}がたくさんあった。
examples.english: When I went to a young photographer's exhibition, there were many beautiful works.

notes:
{写真家|しゃしんか} refers to a professional photographer, especially one with an artistic focus.

WORD FORMATION:
{写真|しゃしん} (photograph) + {家|か} (professional suffix, as in {作家|さっか}, {画家|がか}).

SPECIALIZATIONS:
- {風景|ふうけい}{写真家|しゃしんか}: landscape photographer
- {報道|ほうどう}{写真家|しゃしんか}: photojournalist
- ファッション{写真家|しゃしんか}: fashion photographer
- {野生|やせい}{動物|どうぶつ}{写真家|しゃしんか}: wildlife photographer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- カメラマン: cameraman/photographer (broader, less formal; also used for video camera operators)
- フォトグラファー: photographer (loanword, used in fashion/media)

{写真家|しゃしんか} implies artistic dedication and is the most respectful term for a professional photographer.
